name: GhostAvatar
description: Headless user or entity avatar with SSR-safe image loading and initials or slot fallback. useGhostAvatar owns styling hooks and the client image probe; GhostAvatar is the thin unstyled host. Themed size hooks live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Load is confirmed after mount on the client.

slots.name: fallback
slots.description: Shown when the image is not displayed.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The root host element after mount, or `null` before mount.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Native span or div host when using the default as prop.

parts.name: image
parts.description: img element when the src load succeeded.

parts.name: fallback
parts.description: Inner host for initials or fallback slot content.

states.name: loading
states.description: src is set and the client has not finished probing yet.

states.name: loaded
states.description: src loaded and the img is shown.

states.name: error
states.description: src failed to load; fallback is shown.

keyboard.Tab: Does not land on the avatar unless the consumer adds tabindex.
